views.name: bowling_game_records
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Bowler_Scores.BowlerID AS bowler_id,
  Bowlers.BowlerFirstName AS bowler_first_name,
  Bowlers.BowlerLastName AS bowler_last_name,
  Bowler_Scores.MatchID AS match_number,
  Bowler_Scores.GameNumber AS game_number,
  Bowler_Scores.HandiCapScore AS handicap_score,
  Tournaments.TourneyDate AS tournament_date,
  Tournaments.TourneyLocation AS location,
  Bowler_Scores.WonGame AS game_result
FROM Bowler_Scores
JOIN Bowlers ON Bowler_Scores.BowlerID = Bowlers.BowlerID
LEFT JOIN Tourney_Matches ON Bowler_Scores.MatchID = Tourney_Matches.MatchID
LEFT JOIN Tournaments ON Tourney_Matches.TourneyID = Tournaments.TourneyID
views.description: All game-level records for bowlers with relevant identifying and match fields (bowler id, first/last name, match number, game number, handicap score, tournament date, location, and game result). This is the base cohort from which wins, locations, and handicap filters will be applied.
counter_examples: List the bowlers (including their ID, first name, and last name), match number, game number, handicap score, tournament date, and location for only those bowlers who have won games with a handicap score of 190 or less at all three venues: Thunderbird Lanes, Totem Lanes, and Bolero Lanes. Only include the specific game records where they won with a handicap score of 190 or less at these three locations.

views.name: winning_games_at_three_venues
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  bgr.bowler_id AS bowler_id,
  bgr.bowler_first_name AS bowler_first_name,
  bgr.bowler_last_name AS bowler_last_name,
  bgr.match_number AS match_number,
  bgr.game_number AS game_number,
  bgr.handicap_score AS handicap_score,
  bgr.tournament_date AS tournament_date,
  bgr.location AS location
FROM bowling_game_records bgr
WHERE bgr.game_result = 'W'
  AND bgr.location IN ('Thunderbird Lanes', 'Totem Lanes', 'Bolero Lanes')
views.description: Subset of winning_games further restricted to only rows whose location is one of the three target venues (Thunderbird Lanes, Totem Lanes, Bolero Lanes). Each row remains a single winning-game record at one of those venues.

views.name: bowlers_with_all_three_venues
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  w.bowler_id AS bowler_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT w.location) AS qualifying_venue_count
FROM
  winning_games_at_three_venues AS w
GROUP BY
  w.bowler_id
views.description: Identify bowlers who have at least one qualifying winning game (handicap <=190) at each of the three specific venues by counting distinct qualifying venues per bowler from winning_games_at_three_venues. This produces the set of bowlers eligible for final output.
